title: Days of the Week, Months of the Year and the Calendar
seo_title: Grade 1 Days and Months Worksheets with Answers (MATATAG Math 1)
standard_text: Give the days of the week and months of the year in the correct order; determine the day and month of the year using a calendar; solve problems involving time (hour, half hour, quarter hour, days in a week, and months in a year).
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 calendar worksheets for the DepEd MATATAG curriculum: days of the week, months of the year, reading a calendar and problems. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: 7 days in a week, 12 months in a year.
key_sub: Every 7 days the same day comes back.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • The 7 days of the week: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.
  • The 12 months: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December.
  • A calendar shows the days of a month in rows of 7.
  • Every 7 days, the same day of the week comes back.

Examples

Example

Today is Friday. What day is it in 3 days?

Saturday, Sunday, Monday

Answer: Monday

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Wrong orderSay the days in order every morning.
June or July?June is the 6th month; July is the 7th.
Counting todayCount on from the next day.

faq.q: What does MATATAG Math 1 ask about the calendar?
faq.a: Give the days of the week and months of the year in the correct order, determine the day and month using a calendar, and solve problems involving days in a week and months in a year.

faq.q: How many months are in a year?
Which month has the fewest days?

items.q: What day comes after Wednesday?
items.e: Wednesday, Thursday.

items.q: What day comes before Sunday?
items.e: Saturday, Sunday.

items.q: What day comes after Sunday?
items.e: Sunday, Monday.

items.q: How many days are in a week?
items.e: Monday to Sunday: 7 days.

items.q: What day comes after Friday?
items.e: Friday, Saturday.

items.q: Today is Monday. What day will it be in 2 days?
items.e: Count on 2 days from Monday: Wednesday.

items.q: What day comes before Friday?
items.e: Thursday, Friday.

items.q: What day comes before Wednesday?
items.e: Tuesday, Wednesday.

items.q: What day comes before Tuesday?
items.e: Monday, Tuesday.

items.q: What day comes after Saturday?
items.e: Saturday, Sunday.

items.q: Today is Sunday. What day will it be in 2 days?
items.e: Count on 2 days from Sunday: Tuesday.

items.q: What day comes after Monday?
items.e: Monday, Tuesday.

items.q: What day comes after Tuesday?
items.e: Tuesday, Wednesday.

items.q: What day comes before Thursday?
items.e: Wednesday, Thursday.

items.q: What day comes after Thursday?
items.e: Thursday, Friday.

items.q: What day comes before Monday?
items.e: Sunday, Monday.

items.q: Today is Friday. What day will it be in 2 days?
items.e: Count on 2 days from Friday: Sunday.

items.q: What day comes before Saturday?
items.e: Friday, Saturday.

items.q: Today is Thursday. What day will it be in 2 days?
items.e: Count on 2 days from Thursday: Saturday.

items.q: Today is Saturday. What day will it be in 2 days?
items.e: Count on 2 days from Saturday: Monday.

items.q: What month comes before July?
items.e: June, July.

items.q: What month comes before June?
items.e: May, June.

items.q: In which month is Christmas?
items.e: Christmas is in December.

items.q: What month comes after July?
items.e: July, August.

items.q: What month comes after April?
items.e: April, May.

items.q: Which month is the 9th month of the year?
items.e: Count the months from January: September.

items.q: What month comes after October?
items.e: October, November.

items.q: In which month is New Year's Day?
items.e: New Year's Day is in January.

items.q: Which month is the 3rd month of the year?
items.e: Count the months from January: March.

items.q: What month comes before May?
items.e: April, May.

items.q: In which month is All Saints' Day?
items.e: All Saints' Day is in November.

items.q: Which month is the 7th month of the year?
items.e: Count the months from January: July.

items.q: What month comes after February?
items.e: February, March.

items.q: In which month is Valentine's Day?
items.e: Valentine's Day is in February.

items.q: In which month is Bonifacio Day?
items.e: Bonifacio Day is in November.

items.q: In which month is Rizal Day?
items.e: Rizal Day is in December.

items.q: What month comes before October?
items.e: September, October.

items.q: What month comes after December?
items.e: December, January.

items.q: What month comes before February?
items.e: January, February.

items.q: What month comes after May?
items.e: May, June.

items.q: Which month does this calendar show?
items.e: The month is at the top: June 2,027. (Sunday is a day, not a month.)

items.q: What day is June 1?
items.e: Find 1. Go up to the top of its column: Tue. June 1 is a Tuesday. (A month does not always start on Sunday.)

items.q: What day is June 10?
items.e: Find 10. Go up to the top of its column: Thursday.

items.q: What day is June 19?
items.e: Find 19. Go up to the top of its column: Saturday.

items.q: What day is June 27?
items.e: Find 27. Go up to the top of its column: Sunday.

items.q: What is the date of the first Friday in June?
items.e: Go down the Fri column. The first number is 4. It is June 4. (June 1 is the first date, but it is a Tuesday.)

items.q: Which date is a Monday?
items.e: Look in the Mon column: 7, 14, 21, 28. So June 14 is a Monday. (June 13 is a Sunday.)

items.q: How many Sundays are in June?
items.e: The Sundays are 6, 13, 20, 27. That is 4 Sundays. (27 is the date of the last one.)

items.q: What date comes just after June 15?
items.e: The next date is one more: 15 + 1 = 16. (June 22 is the date under it, one week later.)

items.q: What date comes just before June 13?
items.e: The date before is one less: 13 − 1 = 12. It is at the end of the row above. (June 6 is the date above 13, one week before.)

items.q: What is the last day of June?
items.e: The last number on the calendar is 30. So it is June 30. (June has 30 days. There is no June 31.)

items.q: What day is the last day of June?
items.e: The last date is 30. Go up its column: Wednesday. (Saturday is the end of the row, not the last day.)

items.q: The Terry Fox Run is circled. What is the date?
items.e: The red circle is around 24. The run is on September 24.

items.q: What day is the Terry Fox Run?
items.e: Go up from the circled 24 to the top: Friday.

items.q: The first day of school is in the green box. What is the date?
items.e: The green box is around 7. School starts on September 7.

items.q: What day is the first day of school?
items.e: Go up from 7 to the top: Tuesday. (Monday, September 6 is Labour Day.)

items.q: Andrea’s birthday is September 15. What day is that?
items.e: Find 15. Go up to the top of its column: Wednesday.

items.q: Which date is a Saturday?
items.e: Look in the Sat column: 4, 11, 18, 25. So September 18 is a Saturday. (September 19 is a Sunday.)

items.q: How many Fridays are in September?
items.e: The Fridays are 3, 10, 17, 24. That is 4 Fridays.

items.q: September 30 is the last day. What day will October 1 be?
items.e: September 30 is a Thursday. October 1 is the next day: Friday. (A new month does not always start on Sunday.)

items.q: The 1st of September is a Saturday. What day is September 5?
items.e: Every 7 days the same day comes back. September 5 is Wednesday.

items.q: The 1st of November is a Friday. What day is November 24?
items.e: Every 7 days the same day comes back. November 24 is Sunday.

items.q: The 1st of May is a Saturday. What day is May 16?
items.e: Every 7 days the same day comes back. May 16 is Sunday.

items.q: The 1st of March is a Tuesday. What day is March 25?
items.e: Every 7 days the same day comes back. March 25 is Friday.

items.q: The 1st of October is a Friday. What day is October 25?
items.e: Every 7 days the same day comes back. October 25 is Monday.

items.q: How many days are in 1 week?
The 1st of February is a Monday. What day is February 1?
items.e: Every 7 days the same day comes back. February 1 is Monday.

items.q: How many days are in 2 weeks?
The 1st of September is a Monday. What day is September 1?
items.e: Every 7 days the same day comes back. September 1 is Monday.

items.q: The 1st of August is a Thursday. What day is August 28?
items.e: Every 7 days the same day comes back. August 28 is Wednesday.

items.q: How many days are in 4 weeks?
The 1st of April is a Thursday. What day is April 26?
items.e: Every 7 days the same day comes back. April 26 is Monday.

items.q: The 1st of March is a Friday. What day is March 27?
items.e: Every 7 days the same day comes back. March 27 is Wednesday.

items.q: The 1st of August is a Thursday. What day is August 25?
items.e: Every 7 days the same day comes back. August 25 is Sunday.

items.q: How many days are in 3 weeks?
The 1st of January is a Friday. What day is January 30?
items.e: Every 7 days the same day comes back. January 30 is Saturday.

items.q: The 1st of November is a Tuesday. What day is November 14?
items.e: Every 7 days the same day comes back. November 14 is Monday.

items.q: The 1st of November is a Sunday. What day is November 14?
items.e: Every 7 days the same day comes back. November 14 is Saturday.

items.q: The 1st of October is a Wednesday. What day is October 20?
items.e: Every 7 days the same day comes back. October 20 is Monday.

items.q: The 1st of October is a Monday. What day is October 2?
items.e: Every 7 days the same day comes back. October 2 is Tuesday.

items.q: How many days are in 1 week?
items.e: Sunday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday. That is 7 days. (5 is only the school days.)

items.q: How many school days are in 1 week?
items.e: Monday to Friday are school days. That is 5 days. (7 counts the weekend too.)

items.q: How many days are in the weekend?
items.e: Saturday and Sunday. That is 2 days.

items.q: How many days are in 2 weeks?
items.e: 1 week is 7 days. 7 + 7 = 14 days. (7 is only 1 week.)

items.q: Jomar’s cousin stays for 1 week and 2 days. How many days is that?
items.e: 1 week is 7 days. 7 + 2 = 9 days. (3 adds 1 + 2. It forgets that a week is 7 days.)

items.q: Today is June 9. How many days until Maria’s party?
items.e: Count the jumps from 9 to 12: 10, 11, 12. That is 3. Do not count today. (4 counts today too.)

items.q: Today is June 14. How many days until the field trip?
items.e: Count the jumps from 14 to 18: 15, 16, 17, 18. That is 4. Do not count today. (5 counts today too.)

items.q: Today is June 2. How many days until the class picnic?
items.e: Count the jumps from 2 to 9: 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9. That is 7. Do not count today. 9 is right under 2. That is 1 week. (8 counts today too.)

items.q: Today is June 21. How many days until the soccer game?
items.e: Count the jumps from 21 to 26: 22, 23, 24, 25, 26. That is 5. Do not count today. (6 counts today too.)

items.q: Today is June 15. What is the date 1 week from today?
items.e: 1 week is 7 days. 15 + 7 = 22. Go straight down one row: June 22. (June 21 counts today as day 1. June 8 is 1 week ago.)

items.q: Today is June 8. What is the date 3 days from today?
items.e: Count on 3: 9, 10, 11. It is June 11. (June 10 counts today as day 1. June 5 counts back.)

items.q: How many weeks from the first swim class to the swimming test?
items.e: 21 is 2 rows straight under 7. Each row down is 1 week. That is 2 weeks. (3 weeks counts the rows, not the jumps.)

items.q: How many days are in June?
items.e: The last date is 30. June has 30 days. (7 is the days in one row. 5 is the rows.)

items.q: Angelo crosses off each day that is done. Today is November 10. How many days are crossed off?
items.e: The Xs are on 1 to 9. That is 9 days. (10 counts today too, but today is not done yet.)

items.q: How many Mondays are in November?
items.e: The Mondays are 1, 8, 15, 22, 29. That is 5 Mondays. (29 is the date of the last one.)

items.q: Today is November 4. How many days until Remembrance Day?
items.e: Count the jumps from 4 to 11: 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11. That is 7. Do not count today. 11 is right under 4. That is 1 week. (8 counts today too.)

items.q: Kenneth swims every Tuesday. How many times does he swim in 2 weeks?
items.e: There is 1 Tuesday in each week. 1 + 1 = 2 times. (14 is the days in 2 weeks.)

items.q: Today is Friday. The field trip is on Monday. How many days until the field trip?
items.e: Count on from Friday: Saturday (1), Sunday (2), Monday (3). That is 3 days. (4 counts today too.)

items.q: Today is Sunday. Arnel has volleyball on Saturday. How many days until volleyball?
items.e: Count on: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat. That is 6 days. (7 counts today too.)

items.q: School started on September 7. Today is September 14. How many days ago did school start?
items.e: Count the jumps from 7 to 14: 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14. That is 7. Do not count today. 14 is right under 7. That is 1 week. (8 counts today too.)
